description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy results of an ablation study, comparing performance across different conditions related to misinformation detection models named “PHEME” and “Politifact”. The horizontal axis displays the categories: “Ours,” “w/o comments,” “w/o text,” “w/o select,” “w/o emotion,” and “w/o cognition,” with labels rotated for readability. The vertical axis represents “Accuracy (%)” on a linear scale ranging from 75.0 to 95.0, with tick marks at intervals of 2.5. For the PHEME model, bars are colored in shades of red and pink; “Ours” is represented by a red bar extending to 89.84, “w/o comments” has a pink bar at 86.82, “w/o text” is a red bar at 88.80, “w/o select” is a pink bar at 87.34, “w/o emotion” is a red bar at 87.17, and “w/o cognition” is a pink bar at 80.10. For the Politifact model, bars are depicted in shades of blue: “Ours” is a dark red bar at 90.57, “w/o comments” is an orange bar at 85.85, “w/o text” is a dark blue bar at 83.02, “w/o select” is a light blue bar at 84.91, “w/o emotion” is a medium blue bar at 87.74, and “w/o cognition” is a light blue bar at 89.62. The bars are arranged alphabetically by category label. A vertical dashed line visually separates the PHEME and Politifact data.
